note: 2D period field map. Each pair-domain maps two raw positive fields on the SAME object. No modulus, no x0 (asserted at load). ln taken at test time.

velocity_luminosity.description: The one feasible 2D pair from the 1D survey: Gaia transverse velocity (3.3 dec) x luminosity (4.0 dec), same star. Both coordinates resolve low-mid registers. SCRAMBLE NULL decides whether any joint lock is real or marginal (Form B). SERVED BY: the synthetic control lakes now (test fixtures, meta.synthetic=true), and the real Gaia velocity-luminosity pair lake when promoted (meta.synthetic absent).

synthetic_controls.note: The synthetic control lakes (L_synth_noise, L_synth_jointlock, L_synth_formB, L_synth_oneaxis) all carry domain 'velocity_luminosity' and route through the entry below. They are distinguished from real data by meta.synthetic=true and meta.control_role. They are standing regression fixtures -- see lakes2d_period/synthetic/synthetic_manifest.json for their pre-registered expected verdicts.
